title: ParquetToXL export configuration (proposal)
description: Versioned export intent, separate from measured metadata and generated manifests. See partitioning-spec.md for the planning rules and export-pipeline-spec.md for selection, staging and publication.

config_id.description: Stable identity for output-directory ownership. Not the file path, so renaming or moving this file does not read as a different configuration. The web editor allocates it and guarantees uniqueness across configurations.

config_modified_utc.description: T3. When this configuration was last changed. Maintained by the author or the web editor; a forgotten bump is caught by the resolved-config hash recorded in the run receipt.

output_directory.description: May be remote. Writers only ever see local scratch; remote access is confined to stage-in and publish.

scratch_root.description: null means tempfile.gettempdir(). Overridable on the CLI. On many Spark images /tmp is RAM-backed, so staged Parquet and written workbooks come out of the same memory the export competes for.

writer.description: polars-xlsxwriter is refused: it is not round-trip safe (Float64 loses precision, 1900-01-01 shifts back a day), so selecting it would make every verification fail for reasons unrelated to the data.

propertyNames.description: Source alias. Same pattern as a profile name, because both are interpolated into output names.

oneOf.description: Needs write access to the source location, which a read-only container will not give.

date_columns.description: Keyed by exact column name within THIS source. Names collide across sources, and the same name may be a date in one file and a YYYYMM integer in another.

oneOf.description: Use the source's local calendar date, consistent with the ToExcel policy. Required for naive input in v1.
Convert timezone-aware input to this IANA zone before deriving partition keys.

dateColumn.description: Selected on `type`, the same discriminator the Pydantic union uses, so both sides have one shape per kind. Branch-specific fields live inside the `then` blocks rather than in the outer `properties`, which is what lets `unevaluatedProperties` reject a field belonging to another kind. Written with if/then rather than oneOf so a failure names the offending field instead of reporting that nothing matched.

two_digit_year_window_start.description: YY selects the unique year ending in YY in this fixed, inclusive 100-year window. Stays optional here and is made conditional below, matching IntDateColumn.

source.description: An alias declared in the top-level sources object.

partition_column.description: A column registered in THIS source's date_columns. null only when the profile's algorithm is balanced.

sort.description: Lexicographic precedence over this source's columns. Calendar exports sort within each final sheet; balanced exports sort globally before slicing. Empty means source order.

year_split_months.description: Candidate calendar grids in preference order; the semantic validator requires strictly descending order ending in 1. Used only for an oversized base year.

oneOf.description: The partition column is per sheet, not here: each source has its own date column. These settings define the one shared grid every sheet is bucketed against.

workbook.description: Filename template including .xlsx; supports profile, period_label and workbook_index. Validated against the union of Windows, Azure and POSIX name rules regardless of host OS.

worksheet.description: Must contain {source} when the profile has more than one sheet, or every source renders the same name in a shared workbook.

overflow_worksheet.description: Used when a calendar bucket must be split by rows; supports period_label and part_index, and {source} under the same rule as worksheet.

month_format.description: Formats month period labels and ranges: numeric gives 2025-01~06; abbreviated gives 2025-Jan~Jun. All ranges use ~; cross-year ranges repeat the year.

worksheet_prefix.description: Literal prefix prepended with one space to every rendered worksheet name, including single-sheet and overflow names. Empty means no prefix. Counts toward the 31-character limit. Does not affect workbook filenames.

output_subdirectory.description: Resolved under output_directory. Owned exclusively by this profile: two profiles resolving to one directory is a validation error, and a foreign receipt there refuses the run.

sheets.description: One worksheet per entry per partition bucket. Several entries make a fan-in workbook drawing from several Parquet files.

max_cells_per_workbook.description: Enforced planning ceiling: all exported cells, including null positions and one header row per worksheet, summed across every sheet in the workbook. A capacity policy, not an Excel RAM guarantee.
